run_generate_scannet_test: run the script to generate ScanNet test scene .pth files for validation and test splits
create_test_pth_from_frames: create a test .pth data dict from a sequence directory and selected frame indices
process_scannet_sequence: process a single ScanNet sequence into multiple .pth files with varying frame skip rates
review_make_test_pth: review the make_test_pth function that builds a data dict with color paths, depth paths, poses, and intrinsics
refactor_process_scannet_seq: refactor process_scannet_seq to support configurable frame skip values and multiple random start positions
